name: SkillWeaver
institution: The Ohio State University (OSU-NLP-Group), University of Virginia, Purdue University, Carnegie Mellon University, Cisco Research
what_evolved: Tools技能 (skill library / API action space). A growing library of reusable Python-API skills; NO model weight updates — evolution is purely in the external skill/artifact layer.
skill_as_artifact: Yes. Skills exist as independent, plug-and-play, transferable artifacts: Python functions (Playwright browser-automation code) each with a signature, docstring (incl. usage log + prerequisite state) and code body, stored in a knowledge base and shared across agents.
skill_encoding: Executable code / API. Each skill is a Python function wrapping Playwright actions, plus a natural-language docstring recording prior executions and required preconditions.
skill_granularity: 子任务workflow. Three task types are abstracted into single callable APIs: procedural (multi-step automation), navigational (site mapping), and information-seeking (scraping).
how_method: rollout_optimization(非梯度) + imitation_demonstration. Three-stage pipeline: (I) Skill Proposal (LLM auto-curriculum proposes diverse skills), (II) Skill Synthesis (agent practices tasks; an LLM reward model judges success; successful state-action trajectories are distilled into generalized Python APIs with static analysis), (III) Skill Honing (auto-generated test cases + environment feedback debug/refine APIs). No gradient updates.
learning_signal_source: 成败轨迹 (success/failure practice trajectories) + LLM-as-judge (an LLM reward model provides task-completion signals from trajectory + screenshots + env feedback).
reward_granularity: outcome (binary task-completion success judged by the reward model per practice attempt).
learning_paradigm: Online interactive exploration (agent acts in live environment) combined with offline skill distillation; on-policy (agent learns from its own trajectories).
when_evolve: inter-test-time. A self-driven curriculum exploration/synthesis phase runs offline on a new website BEFORE task execution; skills are then reused at test time. Honing also occurs during/after practice.
trigger: curriculum(课程)驱动 (LLM acts as automatic curriculum proposing novel skills) + failure触发 (runtime errors during testing trigger API patching/recovery).
library_structure: 技能文件 / flat per-website knowledge base. Synthesized APIs stored as code files (e.g. kb_post_code.py) with metadata; iteratively expanded over exploration iterations.
retrieval_method: 代码直接复用 — synthesized APIs are loaded into the agent's action space as callable tools (Browser-Use converts KB into a Controller extending the action space); the LLM selects which API to invoke per task. [uncertain]
validation: execution-based (auto-generated unit tests run the API standalone or with LLM-generated parameters) + LLM-judge (reward model) + validation gating (only verified, error-free APIs are exposed by default; --allow-unverified-apis flag controls this).
error_correction: self-revision via bounded patches. On runtime exceptions during testing (--allow-recovery), the agent locates the faulty section (e.g. ambiguous DOM selector) and applies a targeted diff to make the API robust.
test_env: Web — WebArena (Gitlab, Map, Shopping, CMS, Reddit) and real-world live websites (Online-Mind2Web: Drug, Flight, Cooking, Car).
backbone_model: GPT-4o (default agent / API-synthesis / success-check LM); GPT-4o-mini tested as weaker agent; Azure OpenAI supported.
where_deploy: specialized (web/GUI automation). General-purpose autonomous web navigation agents.
metrics: success_rate (relative improvement), generalization (cross-agent & cross-website transfer), skill_library_growth (per-iteration), cost.
key_results: WebArena: +31.8% relative success rate (GPT-4o 22.6→29.8; GPT-4o-mini +45%, up to +133% on CMS). Real-world Online-Mind2Web: +39.8% (40.2→56.2). Cross-agent transfer: APIs from strong agents boost weaker agents by up to +54.3% on WebArena. Gains achievable with ~160 exploration iterations.
limitations: transferability/scalability: relies on accessibility-tree DOM parsing — websites that fail to parse into a natural accessibility tree hinder performance; per-website exploration cost. controllability: agent sometimes fails to invoke or misuses generated APIs. skill quality is backbone-dependent (weak models produce buggy/unreusable skills).
